other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Upstream oil production facilities where crude oil is continuously stabilized for sale and produced water is treated for injection
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
This production is
transported by flow lines to two main production facilities (SPF, NPF) where oil is stabilized for sale and
water is treated for injection and re-injection.
other_continuous_flow_signals.sector: upstream oil & gas production (crude stabilization / water treatment facility)

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: On-site power generation for continuous field operations fed by gas, diesel and crude oil
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Field operations require an average of 75 MW which comes from three power generation systems: 21%
from gas, 22% from diesel and 57% from crude oil.

one_line: The paper applies an ISO 50001-based energy management methodology (the "Significance Matrix") to evaluate and optimize electric submersible pump (ESP) artificial-lift systems in upstream heavy-oil production wells in Blocks 16 & 67, Ecuador — a petroleum extraction context, not continuous-flow refining or petrochemical production.
